name: radiology-handbook
description: Guide RadArena agents through chest X-ray report verification or constrained synthetic report editing, with role-specific workflows and on-demand references. Use within the RadArena research pipeline; this handbook is not clinical decision support.
---

# RadArena radiology handbook

Open the index for your assigned role, then select only chapters relevant to the
current question. The application supplies the available chapter catalog and enforces
access. Do not read the entire library linearly.

- Red: [Red role index](references/red-team/SKILL.md).
- Blue/verifier: [Blue role index](references/blue-team/SKILL.md).
- Shared books: [reporting](references/reporting/SKILL.md),
  [medical library](references/medical-library/SKILL.md),
  [tool reference](references/tools/SKILL.md).
- [Source provenance and review status](SOURCES.md).

This project-authored draft requires qualified radiologist review. The library has no
patient cases, gold edits, test answers, or learned memories. It is read-only through
the application interface; writable training memory is separate. Some books may be
unavailable in an ablation condition. Use the catalog actually supplied for this run.

# Blue role index

Verify the candidate using only supplied evidence and permitted tools. Read
[the workflow](workflow.md) for the investigation sequence and
[evidence and uncertainty](evidence.md) for verdict requirements. Use shared reporting
or relevant medical references on demand. Do not request the original report, private
edit log, source labels, or grader answer. Your role has no access to Red's sub-book.

# Tool reference index

Read [tool contracts](contracts.md) to understand each interface, actual implementation
status, and what its outputs mean. The running application's tool registry, not a handbook
description, determines which functions can execute. This book remains available under
the handbook ablations so basic tool access does not change between those conditions.
